The call is the front door

Curious and ready land in the same calendar

The free 15-minute call is the clearest next step on your Linktree. Someone who found you yesterday and someone ready to commit book the same slot, and you sort them out live.

Links, not a path

Everything sits side by side

Community, consultation, discovery call, two podcasts, Substack and website are all listed together, with no prices and no order. A new follower has to pick their own route.

Reach swings

Leads depend on which reel lands

Your last 7 reels ranged from 7,145 to 41.1k views. A quiet week on Instagram means fewer people reaching your call, your community or your coaching.

You already have Client wins and Testimonials highlights doing the persuading. Right now, they only reach the people who tap on them.

Sound familiar?

Is it “all in your head”? Let’s look at the whole picture.

  • You’ve been told your results look fine, and you still don’t feel like yourself.
  • You’ve changed one thing at a time and can’t tell what’s making a difference.
  • You’ve read a hundred posts and still don’t know where to start.
  • You want to understand your own health, not just be told what to do.

Here’s what you’ll learn

Five things we’ll cover in 60 minutes

Why one-at-a-time changes often stall

How everyday habits pull on each other, and why changing one thing on its own can feel like nothing is working.

The four foundations I look at first

Sleep, food, movement and stress. Simple, everyday areas where small, steady changes add up.

How to connect your own dots

A simple way to track your habits and how you feel each day, so patterns start to show up on paper.

Better questions for your doctor

How to go into an appointment prepared, so you and your doctor can work on the full picture together.

Where coaching fits

What working on root-cause habits with a coach looks like, and what it isn’t: no diagnosis, and never a replacement for your doctor.

Meet Jordan

Hi, I’m Jordan

I’m a root cause health coach. My work is connecting the dots of health: looking at how your habits and daily life fit together, and finding answers others can’t. I’ve coached more than 1,000 people.

Alongside 1:1 coaching and mentoring, I host the Organic Optimisation and Real Health Talk podcasts, write on Substack and run a community for people who want to keep learning together.

Questions

Before you save your seat

Is this medical advice?

No. Connect the Dots is a coaching and education class. It doesn’t diagnose or treat anything, and it isn’t a substitute for your doctor.

Should I stop seeing my doctor?

No. Part of the class is about working with your doctor better, with clearer notes and better questions.

What if I can’t make it live?

Register anyway. Everyone who signs up gets the replay.

Is it really free?

Yes. The class, the Q&A, the worksheet and the replay are all free.

Coaching and education only. Not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always speak to your doctor about your health.

If you’ve tried a lot and nothing seems to stick, read this.

Hey [first name],

I hear this a lot: “I’ve tried everything.” The new diet, the earlier bedtime, the new routine.

Usually, what’s been tried is lots of things, one at a time, on your own. When it doesn’t seem to work, it’s easy to decide nothing will.

Coaching is different because we look at the dots together, change things in an order that makes sense for your life, and adjust as we go. And it works alongside your doctor, never instead of them.

If that sounds like what’s been missing, book a free discovery call. If it isn’t the right fit, I’ll tell you.

Ad creatives · Video scripts · Meta

Video ad scripts

Three talking-head scripts, 30 to 45 seconds each, filmed the way you already film your reels.

Script 1 · “Looks normal”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“A lot of the people I talk to have been told ‘everything looks normal’. And they still don’t feel right.”

Body

“That’s where I start. Not with one fix, but with the whole picture: how someone sleeps, eats, moves and handles stress, and how those pieces pull on each other. When you see the dots together, the next step gets a lot clearer.”

CTA

“I’m walking through exactly how I do it in a free live class called Connect the Dots. Tap Sign up to save your seat.”

Shot: close-up to camera, on-screen text “everything looks normal” in a black caption box, the way your grid posts look.

Caption line: Coaching and education, not medical advice.

Script 2 · “Four dots”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Before I look at anything else, I look at four things.”

Body

“Sleep. Food. Movement. Stress. They sound simple, but most people work on one at a time and wonder why nothing seems to shift. In my free class I’ll show you how to track all four together, so you can see your own patterns.”

CTA

“It’s free and it’s live. Tap Sign up below.”

Shot: outdoors with greenery behind you, counting the four on your fingers, a gold dot appearing on screen for each one.

Caption line: Coaching and education, not medical advice.

Script 3 · “Your next appointment”

Hook (0 to 3s)

“Your best doctor’s appointment starts before you walk in the door.”

Body

“Most people walk in, try to remember how the last few weeks went, and walk out with more questions. A few weeks of simple notes on your habits and how you feel, plus the right questions written down, changes that conversation.”

CTA

“I’ll show you how in my free live class, Connect the Dots. Tap Sign up to join me.”

Shot: you writing in a notebook, then turning to camera.

Caption line: Coaching and education, not medical advice.
